payload.title: Freeze target-preserving causal feature-view screen
payload.decision: Execute T027 exactly as preregistered before any formal or neural view-learning implementation.
payload.rationale: T026 shows that additional causal views help within a weak family but fail because view-local targets differ materially from the original competition-boundary target. T027 preserves one target across deterministic subviews of the exact 142-feature E011 legal schema and tests several view pools, weighting regimes, and bounded model families under complete transfer controls.
payload.revisit_trigger: No score-directed retuning. Complete all 21 branches, four placements, 35 contexts, controls, slices, edge cases, and reproduction. No package, neural model, Kaggle execution, or submission is authorized.
